hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: No shuttle, no gap, no two-hour hole in the middle of your day. Say your vows in the Theatre, walk your guests into the Lobby Bar for cocktails, and come back to a room that has been turned over while you were outside having photographs taken. One booking, one building, the same venue for both halves of the day.
objection_1_a: Your guests are in the Lobby Bar with a drink and the doors closed behind them. Our team resets the Theatre. You are on the front steps having photos taken.
objection_2_a: The Theatre has elevated seating, so sightlines work from the back row, and wireless microphones run through Sonos for the vows and the speeches.
objection_3_q: “Can we set the mood the way we want it?”
objection_3_a: The lighting is colour-adjustable and the team walks through colours and music with you beforehand — a past client called that out by name in their review.
timeline_intro: Nobody gets in a car between the vows and the last song.
step_1_name: Guests come up the front steps
step_1_body: Between the two stone lions and through the colonnade. The photos start before anyone is seated.
step_2_body: Elevated seating so everyone actually sees. Wireless mics so everyone hears the vows. Doors close behind your guests.
step_3_body: Full bar, chandeliers, original wood. Your guests never leave the building — and you are outside on the steps having photos taken.
step_4_body: Our team flips the room for dinner while cocktails run next door. Nobody is asked to stand in a hallway.
step_5_body: Plated or family style, out of the building's own kitchen. Speeches on the same microphones the ceremony used.
step_6_body: Lighting drops to your colours, the Sonos takes over, and the bar carries the end of the evening.
gallery_heading: The Rooms, And What Happens In Them
av_intro: The ceremony kit is already in the building. Nothing on this list is a rental line.
av_1_v: Wireless microphones for the vows and the speeches, running through the building's Sonos system. A past client called the speaker system out by name in their review.
av_2_v: A 16-foot video wall in the Theatre. Slideshows, a live feed of the ceremony for guests at the back, or nothing at all.
av_3_v: Colour-adjustable throughout. The team walks through lighting colours with you before the day, the same way they did for the banquet client who wrote about it afterwards.
av_4_v: Elevated velvet seating in the Theatre, so sightlines work without a riser or a rented platform.
av_5_v: Flexible furniture, so the same room becomes the dinner room while your guests are next door with a drink.
why_1_body: An 1880 heritage building with original wood, ornate chandeliers, marble and coloured lighting. Couples arrive with flowers and a cake.
why_2_body: Venue, open bar, catering, AV, furniture, staff and parking quoted together. One team, one invoice, one point of contact.

inquiry_body: Tell us your date and your guest count. You will hear back from the events team, usually within one business day, with a real quote rather than a starting-from figure.
inquiry_note: No commitment required, just a conversation.
